question: Which value of router.power_layer_traces goes into profile enhanced: does none (no trace of any net on a power layer; vias still land in their plane) keep the KiCad-unconnected total within N02's totals rule (accept no-regress, a correctness fix) of own_plane (Q13's rule, accepted by Q13.3), with no trace on a power layer, no via in a pad, no copper below the minimum and no new DRC error?
engine: freerouting-rs at origin/main 9bcade7 with N05's diff (router.power_layer_traces=none), one release build for every arm; unset settings route as origin/main (checked: arm layer on canary-plugin45 must be byte-identical to the plugin run's own session, target/canary-handoff/2026-10-17-plugin45/canary-pwr.ses, sha256 recorded in the done note, else the run stops and is reported)

layer.engine: freerouting-rs at origin/main 9bcade7 with N05's diff (router.power_layer_traces=none), one release build for every arm; unset settings route as origin/main (checked: arm layer on canary-plugin45 must be byte-identical to the plugin run's own session, target/canary-handoff/2026-10-17-plugin45/canary-pwr.ses, sha256 recorded in the done note, else the run stops and is reported)
layer.what: reported: Java's rule, what the plugin's enhanced profile ran (ENHANCED empty)

own_plane.engine: freerouting-rs at origin/main 9bcade7 with N05's diff (router.power_layer_traces=none), one release build for every arm; unset settings route as origin/main (checked: arm layer on canary-plugin45 must be byte-identical to the plugin run's own session, target/canary-handoff/2026-10-17-plugin45/canary-pwr.ses, sha256 recorded in the done note, else the run stops and is reported)
own_plane.what: baseline: Q13's rule, accepted by Q13.3 against layer

none.engine: freerouting-rs at origin/main 9bcade7 with N05's diff (router.power_layer_traces=none), one release build for every arm; unset settings route as origin/main (checked: arm layer on canary-plugin45 must be byte-identical to the plugin run's own session, target/canary-handoff/2026-10-17-plugin45/canary-pwr.ses, sha256 recorded in the done note, else the run stops and is reported)
none.what: candidate: no trace of any net on a power layer

pairs_rule: the verdict pair is judged by the totals block with the hard and guard metrics below (freerouting-dev gate --prereg on a records file written from the graded numbers); the reported pairs' totals are printed, not judged, except that a reported pair with layer as its baseline is not held to drc_real or inner_tracks (layer is the known-bad rule)

boards.eligibility: every row; no row is dropped after a number

canary-plugin45.grade: canary grade.sh steps against canary-pwr-rev1.0 at canary b1994423
canary-plugin45.why: the DSN of Dan's KiCad plugin run of 2026-10-17 (enhanced profile, canary's graded-flow preset): KiCad 45 unconnected, invalid for 2 Power_High via clearance errors and a +12V_BUS track on Power.Cu

canary-plugin68.grade: canary grade.sh steps at canary e21ee05e

canary-9511d9a-mp1.grade: canary grade.sh steps at canary e21ee05e

canary-9511d9a-mp1sweep.grade: canary grade.sh steps at canary e21ee05e

canary-in2-open-mp1.grade: canary grade.sh steps at canary e21ee05e

canary-in2-open-wirekeepout-mp1.grade: canary grade.sh steps at canary e21ee05e

m-fc-g474.grade: tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh with the arm command as the engine, plus canary's via_in_pad.py and inner_tracks.py on the routed board

boards.why: Q13.3's set (power-type layers with more than one plane on a layer) plus the DSN of the plugin run whose +12V_BUS track on Power.Cu made it invalid; the canary rows count as one board

grading: WSL KiCad 10.0.7 for every row, one job at a time, through Q13's path shim. Calibration: arm layer on canary-plugin45 must reproduce the plugin's session byte for byte and grade as Dan's run did (45 unconnected, 2 clearance errors, inner tracks 1); if the grade differs, the canary rev used is named and the run reported, not adjusted. When two arms' sessions are byte-identical the session is graded once. The canary sessions go to target/canary-handoff/2026-10-18-n05/ for canary's official grade

metric_definitions.power_layer_traces: every trace of any net on a power-type layer of the routed DSN (`freerouting-dev power-traces`, the `all` count)
metric_definitions.outside_own_plane: as Q13.json: traces on a power layer of a net with a plane there that leave its planes (`freerouting-dev power-traces`)
metric_definitions.inner_tracks: canary's inner_tracks.py count on the routed board (every track on an inner copper layer; in the in2-open rows Power.Cu is a signal layer, so tracks there count here but not in power_layer_traces)
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: KiCad's unconnected items after importing the session (canary: the count canary's grade prints; corpus: kicad-oracle's unconnected count of the routed board)
metric_definitions.drc_real: canary: KiCad error-severity items other than unconnected items and starved thermals; corpus: kicad-oracle's drc_real
metric_definitions.below_minimum: canary: KiCad track_width errors; corpus: kicad-oracle's copper.below_minimum
metric_definitions.unrouted: the router's final unrouted count (its log); the signal for a row KiCad could not grade

keep_rule: if the verdict passes, N05 adds router.power_layer_traces=none to ENHANCED; otherwise it adds own_plane (accepted by Q13.3) and none stays an off-by-default value with these numbers
stop_rule: one registered run per arm per row; no reruns with other settings
not_registered: canary-pwr placement variants a and a+b, for Q13.json's reason
Q13.3's own sessions are not reused: every arm runs on this engine

decision_table.pass: enhanced gets power_layer_traces=none; N05.3 line; DIVERGENCES Profile enhanced entry
decision_table.fail: enhanced gets own_plane; none stays off, numbers in N05.3

amendments.what: the calibration of arm layer on canary-plugin45 is replaced: this Linux build's own session of the plugin's argument list is the reference, and Dan's plugin grade (45) is reported next to the layer arm's grade, not required of it; the run goes on with the same build, and the three canary-plugin45 sessions already routed are kept
amendments.why: the registered calibration failed before any graded number: arm layer's session (sha256 4d67703c...) differs from the plugin's (5ad40948..., 476 wires against 559). The plugin ran the Windows build (C:\Users\thebo\Documents\code\freerouting-rs\target\release\freerouting.exe, built 2026-10-17 23:25 from the Windows checkout at b491b11 with uncommitted files), not this one. On this build the session does not depend on the DSN's file name, --progress json, --result-json or --threads 1 (all byte-identical apart from the session name), and origin/main's engine changes since b491b11 are Q13's off-by-default setting and K10's CLI flag, so the difference is the binary, which this measurement cannot run; it is an operator observation in N05.3
